{"consolidated_memory":"PLAN DRIFT IN VPC MODULE - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: infra/terraform/vpc.tf (same corner worked across all incidents)
Component: VPC module
Stack: HCL
Check: terraform plan check in CI
Common reproduction: run plan twice with no changes in between
Common signal: a diff on a resource nobody edited

---

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-10] - POST-ROLLING RESTART FAILURE
- Manifestation: turned up only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #1938 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Result: flaky test went from 46 failures per hundred runs to zero

---

INCIDENT 2: [2026-02-12] - FIVE PERCENT ROLLOUT BUCKET
- Manifestation: turned up only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #2350 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
- Result: p99 latency fell from 1.4 s to 316 ms

---

INCIDENT 3: [2026-03-22] - COLD START FAILURE
- Manifestation: turned up only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: the config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #7806 on branch fix/plan-drift-3
- Result: memory settled at 337 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

---

INCIDENT 4: [2026-04-18] - STAGING READ REPLICA
- Manifestation: turned up only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #8965 on branch fix/plan-drift-4
- Result: error rate dropped from 7.0 percent to under 2 per ten thousand"}
